summary.headline: FADU signs KRW 20.4bn supply contract for enterprise SSD controllers, 22.10% of revenue
summary.what_happened: FADU Inc. entered a single supply contract to supply enterprise SSD controllers to an overseas NAND flash memory manufacturer, signed on Nov 25, 2026. The contract is unconditional, with a term from Nov 25, 2026 to May 25, 2027, and payment due within 30 days after delivery. The counterparty's identity and details have been withheld at its request.

key_numbers.label: Buyer cancellation compensation
key_numbers.value: 0.5% of cancelled amount, or direct costs the supplier cannot reduce or avoid, whichever is less

summary.why_it_matters: Single supply contract disclosures in Korea report a contract's size relative to recent revenue, its terms and its timing, so shareholders can gauge the scale of a specific order. Such filings are typically one of many factors investors consider and do not on their own indicate future financial results.
